title: Offboarded clients who never set a password now see just the offboarded message
text: A client whose companies are all being offboarded, and who never set a password, is no longer sent to the "Set Your Password" page. They see only the message that their company is being offboarded, with our support email address, in English or Italian. There is no menu, no other portal page and nothing to set up. A client who already set a password still sees the message with the Chat button, and a client who still has an active company is not affected. Staff can see this screen with View as client.
points: Open an offboarded client in the CRM and press View as client (read-only)
Only offboarded clients who never set a password see this screen
A client who still has an active company sets the password first, as before
